title: Argument tampering — authorization binding under swapped arguments
expected: authorization binds arguments; version swaps refused; approval cannot be reused with tampered arguments
actual: normal path structurally bound; cross-ref swap refused by CAS; tampered approval resubmission REFUSED after the DF-3 fix (found by this scenario earlier in the same dogfood run: binding compared only tool/operation/target/dependencies)
observations: (1) the same normalized intent drives both decision and executor — no swap window exists in the public path
(2) the CAS is ref-scoped: a foreign version cannot satisfy the condition
(3) escalation requested for an unverifiable purge; a human approves it

(3) tampered resubmission REFUSED by approval binding: submitted action does not match the approved escalation for act_s10_esc: approval binds to operation "purge_table", target "none", dependencies [db:table/no-suc
(3-control) untampered resubmission: executed=false, decision=DENY (fail-closed re-verification; the binding let it through)

block_classifications.detail: single normalized intent = structural argument binding
ref-scoped CAS blocks cross-dependency version substitution

notes: DF-3 was discovered and fixed during dogfood; a regression test pins it in test/dogfood/regressions.test.ts.
